episodes.title: REVOLT
episodes.summary: Sybylla is sent to her posh grandmother to be polished for marriage, but her spirited nature leaves a bold impression on high society.

episodes.title: HE
episodes.summary: Sybylla gains a fan from her antics at the party who encourages her to pursue her writing career. She also develops a little crush on someone.

episodes.title: YAH!
episodes.summary: A well-loved family member returns to Caddagat along with a charming guest. Sybylla's talents are recognized and she receives an unexpected offer.

episodes.title: TO LIFE!
episodes.summary: Things at home get more dire but it's time to have some fun. Everyone lets loose at the New Year's party where feelings and tensions rise.

episodes.title: ONE GRAND PASSION
episodes.summary: Secrets and feelings get exposed and everyone is feeling it all. Sybylla makes a huge decision about her future.

episodes.title: TA TA
episodes.summary: Sybylla struggles as a governess but amid chaotic classrooms and never-ending chores, she realizes the value of sacrifice and pursuing her dreams.
